_readme: fra slice (#455) additions. Same shape as patterns.json. Each kp is the PRE-FIX (or still-live) text of a fra_for_eng row, so the regex is calibrated on a real defect. Target-side regexes run on fra_for_eng AND fra_ca_for_eng (tlang 'fra'); known-side ones under 'known:eng' run on every English-known course. Two-sided checks (here|là, sir|monsieur, bare-verb LEGO, pronoun-less LEGO) cannot be expressed in one regex and were run as a separate read of the dump (named in the report).
